items.question: How does this work?
items.answer: We run cold email end to end in ten steps. First we map your ideal customer profile and build a targeted lead list, then write the copy and set up domains, inboxes and DNS. After launch we handle follow-ups, A/B testing, nurturing replies into meetings, and real-time reporting.

items.question: How do we measure success?
items.answer: We measure four things: deliverability, reply rates, meetings booked and conversions. You get real-time tracking and regular reports, so you always see what is working. The targets we aim for are 90%+ email health, a 1%+ reply rate and 20%+ positive replies.

items.question: What's the timeline?
items.answer: Campaigns go live within 18 days of onboarding. That window covers domain and inbox setup, warm-up, building your lead list and writing the copy. First qualified conversations usually come in weeks 3 to 4, and meeting volume becomes consistent by weeks 6 to 8 as we optimise.

items.question: Who sees the best results?
items.answer: B2B businesses see the best results, particularly service providers, SaaS companies, agencies and consultants. These teams sell to a clearly defined set of business buyers, so a targeted list with every prospect handpicked, plus relevant soft-sell copy, starts conversations with exactly the right people.

items.question: How many leads can I expect?
items.answer: Clients typically see 1–3% reply rates, with consistent meetings by weeks 6 to 8. Volume depends on your list and offer: the package sends up to 1,200 emails a day to 5,000 fresh prospects a month, and results improve as we test copy and targeting. Some campaigns convert at 4x the industry average.
